# Teaching Experience

School of Complex Adaptive Systems, Arizona State University

```{r teaching-experience}
# "Spring 2024", "Spring 2027 (scheduled)" -> "Spring 2024, 2027 (scheduled)"
# so the list fits the date column; mixed seasons are listed in full, and a
# list too long for the column breaks after each comma instead of mid-term.
collapse_semesters <- function(x) {
  season <- word(x, 1)
  out <- if (n_distinct(season) == 1) {
    paste0(season[1], " ", paste(str_remove(x, "^\\S+\\s+"), collapse = ", "))
  } else {
    paste(x, collapse = ", ")
  }
  if (nchar(out) > 30) out <- str_replace_all(out, ", ", ",\\\\newline ")
  out
}
esc <- function(x) gsub("([$&%#_])", "\\\\\\1", x)

vroom::vroom("data/teaching-experience.csv") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), trimws)) %>%
  group_by(code, title, designed) %>%
  summarize(semesters = collapse_semesters(semester), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    course    = esc(glue::glue("{code}: {title}")),
    role      = esc(if_else(designed == "Y", "Course Designer & Instructor", "Instructor"))
  ) %>%
  vitae::detailed_entries(
    what = course,
    with = role,
    when = semesters,
    .protect = FALSE
  )
```
